# Wiki sync status

Which pages still need copying into the live Wiki, and where each one sits in the Wiki so it can be
found. See [`README.md`](./README.md) for how the mirror works.

**You do not edit this file.** Say which pages you have pasted and it gets updated for you — the
"synced at" commit has to be the one that last changed that file, which is easy to get wrong by
hand.

**Reading it:** a page is in sync when its file has not changed since the commit in "Synced at".
Anything newer means it has drifted and needs pasting again.

Last reviewed: **2026-09-05**
